The test image shows green bananas with blackening and shriveling at the blossom end of the fruit, resembling a cigar ash. This suggests the affected plant part is the fruit/pod.

Let's read the `part_index.md` file to narrow down the candidate classes.

Based on the `part_index.md` and the observation that the disease affects the pod (fruit), the candidate classes are Anthracnose and Cigar_End_Rot. The visual features of blackening and shriveling at the blossom end strongly align with the description of Cigar_End_Rot.

I will now view reference images, prioritizing Cigar_End_Rot first, then Anthracnose, to confirm the visual similarity.
